name: Pigs in a Blanket
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Unroll crescent dough and separate into triangles. Cut each triangle into 3 smaller triangles.
Place a sausage at the wide end of each triangle and roll toward the point.
Arrange on baking sheet. Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with bagel seasoning.
Bake 12-15 minutes until deep golden brown.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free crescent dough if available.
